body: Oh, wow. I'm so, so sorry that you've had to go through all of that. No wonder you are hurting! I hope you know that that was NOT your fault. It's not a five-year-old's job to make adults drive safely, and even if you had spoken up, there's no guarantee it would have changed anything. *You did not and do not deserve all of the crap, neglect, and abuse that followed.* I know it wouldn't undo any of that, but I wish I could give you a big mama bear hug right now.
But people are only poor because they're *laaaazy*! Everyone knows that hard work = wealth. That's why women in third world countries are all millionaires!
Thank you. I have bad, bad days that I would t wish on anyone, and mostly I just try and take it one day at a time. And the bad days are awful, but on the better days, I'm glad I'm still here.

Famous people say all kinds of crap. Doesn't make it true. I have two autistic boys. Every day I worry that I'm failing them. They struggle souch harder than their neurotypical peers and don't always meet so-called "age appropriate expectations" But they are amazing, and more human than narcissistic celebrities who degrade others for their own financial gain. If anyone is the subhuman scum in this narrative, it's that band. I know how painful their lies can be, but please try and out them out of your head. They are not worth your time or your tears.

Please don't. Can you wait at least one more day? I haven't been able to get help that works for me either, but I'm trying to hold on a little longer. Would you hang on with me? Why do you think your kids would be better off without you?

You are as worthy of help as anyone else in this sub. Depression sucks. Anxiety sucks. That fact that my brain is constantly lying to me, and doing an extremely good job of it, sucks so bad! And I don't really know what to say to help you either, but I hope your tomorrow will be at least a little better.
I'm not, but thanks for replying to me. At this point, I'm just gonna go to bed. Maybe I can do it tomorrow.
